plain.li: [arrive] This is the gate, then.
[arrive,bring] We've brought what was promised.
[arrive,take] We're here for what was agreed.
[arrive,theirLowtech] We left before first light to get here.
[arrive,theirHightech] Right place? Good. Let's get this done.
[arrive,rain] Wet the whole way here.
[arrive,snow] Snow up to the knees on the pass.
[arrive,winter] Cold road. We won't stay long.
[arrive,summer] Hot work, walking that far with a load.
[arrive,morning] Early start. We'd like to be home by dark.
[await] I'll wait here by the gate.
[await,silver] Someone's bringing the silver out, I was told.
[await,food] I'll take the food back to the ones who need it.
[await,medicine] Our healer's waiting on this.
[await,wood] I've brought a strap for the timber.
[await,theirLowtech] Tell your people the runner has come.
[deliver,silver] Count it if you like. It's all there.
[deliver,silver,theirLowtech] Every coin, as the elders said.
[deliver,silver,theirHightech] There's your payment, to the last coin.
[deliver,food] Mind that sack, the seam's going.
[deliver,medicine] Keep these dry and they'll keep.
[deliver,wood] Stacked it as straight as I could.
[deliver,goods] That's the lot. Have a look through it.
[deliver] Set down safe.
[collect,food] Good weight to these.
[collect,food,theirLowtech] There'll be bread at home tonight.
[collect,silver] I'll count it again on the road.
[collect,wood] Dry timber. They'll be glad of it at home.
[collect,medicine] This'll be with the sick by tomorrow.
[collect] One load done. Now the rest.
[receive] That's what I came for.
[receive,silver] All here. I'll see it gets where it's going.
[receive,food] This will be shared out tonight.
[receive,medicine] Our healer will be glad of this.
[receive,wood] Home before dark with this, if the road's kind.
[leave] Long walk home.
[leave,theirLowtech] Back before the moon's up, if we hurry.
[leave,rain] Back out into the wet, then.
[inperson,silver] Here. As we agreed.
[inperson] This is yours now.
[inperson,goods] Yours. Look it over.
[inperson,food] It isn't much, but it's good.

warm.li: [arrive] Your fields look well from the road.
[deliver] With thanks from all of us.
[receive] We won't forget who sent this.
[inperson] For your trouble, and with thanks.

cheerful.li: [arrive] Made good time on the road!
[collect] A full load. My back's complaining already.

gloomy.li: [arrive] My feet won't forgive me for this road.
[deliver] Heavier than it looks, all of it.
[collect] Uphill all the way back, with this.
[await] I'll stand here till someone tells me otherwise.

cold.li: [collect] As agreed. No more, no less.
[receive] Received. We'll be on our way.
